description: Encrypted batches (BATCH-002 to BATCH-006). Each case fixes a batch blob and how to open it. `producer` says which implementation made the bytes (`rust` or `ts-seed`). `recipient_private_key_hex` opens `access_key_base64` (standard Base64 of enc || ciphertext) to `batch_key_hex`, which decrypts `blob_hex` (lowercase hex of nonce[12] || ciphertext+tag) to gzip(msgpack([bin, ...])). The array elements are `encoded_events_hex`; `content_hashes_hex` and `end_hash_hex` follow BATCH-006 from a zero start. `events` is the logical content after decoding (bytes as {"$hex": ...}). `encoding` is `canonical` (the Rust producer's exact bytes), `legacy_int_arrays` (BATCH-004 legacy form) or `future_type` (BATCH-003 unknown type).
